newsitem.title: UK: Crown Products makes profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Crown Products makes profit warning.

text.p: Crown Products Group Plc said on Thursday that results for the 18 months to December 31, 1996 are likely to be below market expectations.

The firm said it has suffered a number of non-recurring costs in the final quarter associated with merging TAG and Levercrest to one location and consolidating and reorganising its giftware sales force.
It said it has also been hit by the strength of the pound.
Crown said that turnover for the current period will still exceed 30 million stg and that it continues to trade profitably.

Crown, an international giftware and children's creative play goods company, said its focus on establishing infrastructure for rapid growth and the introduction of new products is expected to have a strongly positive impact in 1997.
The company also announced that it has strengthened its relationship with The Walt Disney Company Limited by securing rights to distribute plush products (soft toys) in the UK and Eire.
It has also secured the rights to distribute Figi products in the UK and Eire. Figi is based in California.
